name: E10_1_dwynen_other_elf_creatures_you_control_get_plus_one_plus_one
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Other Elf creatures you control get +1/+1.' Seat 0 controls Dwynen (3/4, itself an Elf Warrior), an Elf Warrior (2/2) and a Goblin (2/2). Seat 1 controls an Elf (2/2). Only the other Elf creature seat 0 controls gets the bonus: the Elf Warrior is 3/3. Dwynen is not 'other' (3/4), the Goblin is no Elf (2/2) and seat 1's Elf is not one seat 0 controls (2/2).
